## Submission checklist

- Record the question source, submission date, and any allowed collaboration.
- State assumptions and units before calculations.
- Keep R code, results, and written interpretation together.
- Cite external data and references; do not include restricted material.
- Run `quarto render` and review the final page before submitting.
